content.title: Coachella 2026: Justin Bieber fans turn the festival into Bieberchella
content.text: Beliebers were lining up bright and early to be the first to enter the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival grounds and secure their spot at the barricade for Justin Bieber’s 11:25 p.m. headliner performance Sunday, April 11. Maile Ordaz of San Diego shows off her Justin Bieber nails during day two of the Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival in Indio on Saturday, April 11, 2026. (Photo by Drew A. Kelley, Press-Telegram/SCNG) 1 of 5Maile Ordaz of San Diego shows off her Justin Bieber nails during day two of the Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival in Indio on Saturday, April 11, 2026. (Photo by Drew A. Kelley, Press-Telegram/SCNG) Expand Hype for Bieber’s debut Coachella set started growing earlier in the week and residents in the Palm Desert area starting sharing clips from Bieber’s soundcheck that they could hear from their yard. It’s reported that after snippets were posted online, ticket resell prices for the sold-out event started going for $4,000. Fans were lined up for Bieber’s exclusive Coachella merchandise all day on Friday, April 10, the day before his performance, with wait time taking anywhere from 30 minutes to an hour. Bieber’s comeback performance marks the first time the pop-star has performed on this scale since 2022, where he announced he needed to cancel the rest of the Justice World Tour to prioritize his health. Earlier this year, Bieber performed a stripped down version of “Yukon” at the Grammy Awards.
